_comment: Register the holdings-tools MCP server in Claude Desktop (macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json | Linux: ~/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json | Windows: %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json), Cursor (.cursor/mcp.json), or Gemini CLI (~/.gemini/settings.json). On Windows, set command to C:\path\to\AdvisorBot\.venv\Scripts\python.exe and args to C:\path\to\AdvisorBot\Scripts\mcp_server.py.
